I haven't set up the 07:45 "Strategic pod brief," and I've replied in the thread to explain why.

This session can't run a recurring post into Slack. A scheduled job from here saves its output locally and doesn't deliver it to the channel, so it would run without posting anything. A daily 07:45 brief needs a Slack-connected scheduler, which an admin would have to configure.

I can post a brief here whenever you ask. It would cover new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford, all of which you're in.
